title: AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher
abstract: arXiv:2611.26510v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable habits and elicit underrepresented effective behaviors during teacher rollouts, then fine-tunes a target model on the resulting trajectories. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system in which an LLM agent develops these interventions through trajectory analysis, skill design, data selection, and feedback from rollouts and target-model evaluation. Across Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks with 4B and 9B target models, AutoMaster improves mean performance over Vanilla SFT on successful unguided teacher trajectories by 1.42-8.99 percentage points, with the teacher, task pool, training set size,

translated_title: AutoMaster：通过让同一模型成为更好的教师来实现自主后训练
translated_abstract: 仅凭任务成功并不能确定后训练应该强化哪些行为。即使是成功的教师轨迹也可能包含缺乏依据的假设、无效的重复或肤浅的验证。我们提出了Skill-FT（技能引导微调），该方法使用自然语言技能在教师模型 rollout 过程中抑制不良习惯并激发代表性不足的有效行为，然后在由此产生的轨迹上对目标模型进行微调。我们介绍了AutoMaster，这是一个自主后训练系统，其中一个LLM智能体通过轨迹分析、技能设计、数据选择以及来自 rollout 和目标模型评估的反馈来开发这些干预措施。在使用4B和9B目标模型的终端（Terminal）、搜索（Search）和软件工程任务中，相较于在成功且无引导的教师轨迹上进行朴素SFT，AutoMaster将平均性能提升了1.42-8.99个百分点，且教师模型、任务池、训练集规模（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了Skill-FT技能引导微调方法和AutoMaster自主后训练系统，由LLM智能体自动分析教师轨迹并设计自然语言技能干预来抑制不良习惯、激发有效行为，从而在多个任务上比朴素SFT提升1.42-8.99个百分点的性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Skill-FT and AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system where an LLM agent automatically designs natural-language skill interventions to suppress undesirable habits and elicit effective behaviors in teacher trajectories, improving performance by 1.42-8.99 percentage points over vanilla SFT across Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks.
